surface.label: Team
surface.purpose: Who works here, what each of them may do, and who has been asked in but has not arrived yet

overview.empty: Nobody here yet. Paste a list of people into the chat — name and email, any shape — and they will be added with a role and a sign-in link.
overview.noneWaiting: Nobody is waiting on an invitation.

detail.rolesNote: Roles are preset files, so changing one changes it everywhere. Switching a role off takes effect on the next sign-in — a token already issued carries its rights until it expires.
detail.noInvite: No invitation on file. This person has a card but was never asked into the console.

member.label: Team member
member.description: One person who works here: their card, their role and whether they can sign in

invite.label: Invitation
invite.description: An address that is allowed in and the role it gets on arrival, plus whether its letter landed

access.label: Access
access.description: What each person was given: the role preset, the group tags, and whether they can get in

member_import.label: Add people from a list
member_import.description: Paste a list of people — name and email, in any shape — or name uploaded files. Everyone gets an account, the role you choose, a staff card and a sign-in link. Running the same list twice adds nobody twice.

member_create.label: Add one person
member_create.description: File a card for somebody who works here. This does not give them console access — use the import for that.

member_save.label: Save card
member_save.description: Save changes to a staff member’s card.

member_setRole.label: Change role
member_setRole.description: Give somebody a different role. Roles are preset files; owner is not among the ones that can be handed out here.

member_deactivate.label: Switch off access
member_deactivate.description: Mark somebody as no longer working here and revoke their open invitation. A token already issued keeps working until it expires.

invite_revoke.label: Revoke invitation
invite_revoke.description: Shut an address out before it has been used. Immediate — the gate reads the invitation on every request.

shift_create.label: Schedule a shift
shift_create.description: Put a person on a shift for a time window.

errors.noEmail: This card has no email, so there is no account to give a role to
